title: Kissed Earthy Brazilian Chickpea Casseroles
description: Earthy, fluffy Brazilian dish featuring chickpea flour, perfect for meal prep, and egg-free-friendly, baked in individual mini cocottes. This recipe combines the richness of Brazilian cuisine with the convenience of a casserole.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the chickpea flour and water until smooth.
Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat and saute the diced onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
Add the diced bell pepper and cook until tender.
Stir in the canned diced tomatoes, salt, and black pepper.
Pour the chickpea flour mixture into the skillet and stir to combine.
Divide the mixture among 6 individual mini cocottes.
Bake for 25 minutes or until the edges are lightly golden.
Remove from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving.
